name: Chhatrapati Sq Flyover Multi-Vehicle Crash
title: Chhatrapati Sq Flyover Multi-Vehicle Crash
description: Multi-car collision on flyover ascent blocking 2 lanes towards Ajni with heavy gridlock.
recommendedAction: Immediate Interceptor SUV & Heavy Towing Crane dispatch from Reserve Pool.

name: Sitabuldi Metro Underpass Flash Flood
title: Sitabuldi Metro Underpass Flash Flood
description: Sudden cloudburst waterlogging 2.5 ft deep at Variety Chowk underpass. Traffic diverted to Tekdi Rd.
recommendedAction: Deploy 2 Traffic marshals to seal underpass ramp and reroute via Wardha Rd.

name: Wadi NH-53 Chemical Tanker Breakdown
title: Wadi NH-53 Chemical Tanker Breakdown
description: Heavy articulated container breakdown occupying inner lanes. Tailback reaching 3.5 km onto Amravati bypass.
recommendedAction: Authorize Highway Interceptor & Towing Crane to establish contra-flow corridor.

name: Sakkardara Festival Procession Surge
title: Sakkardara Festival Procession Surge
description: Unscheduled religious procession with 5,000+ devotees converging on Sakkardara lake road.
recommendedAction: Redeploy Beat Patrols from Zone 3 reserve to establish manual pedestrian barricades.
